identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open, Exploratory Clinical Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of EGFR/B7H3 CAR-T in Patients With EGFR/ B7H3-positive Advanced Solid Tumors (Lung and Triple-negative Breast Cancer)

conditions: EGFR/ B7H3-positive Advanced Triple-negative Breast Cancer

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety by Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) V5.0
primaryOutcomes.description: The type, frequency, severity, and duration of adverse events as a result of EGFR/B7H3 CAR-T cells infusion will be summarized
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: In CAR-T cells infusion, up to 52 weeks.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours (RECIST 1.1) assessed by MRI or CT. ORR is the percentage of patients at Complete Response (CR) or Partial Response (PR) (according to independent review), prior to progression or further anti-cancer therapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: In CAR-T cells infusion, up to 52 weeks.
